title: Subdivision tree removal letter from Arborist Committee
summary: On July 8, a homeowner testified against a subdivision board's plan to remove trees. A letter to the subdivision's board was to go on the August agenda for the committee to approve, and the chair asked to be told of the board's next meeting so a committee member could attend.
